notes: WindowShopperToken (src/WindowShopperToken.sol) is the IMDwindowshopper (WWW) token: a plain, fixed-supply ERC-20 built on OpenZeppelin Contracts 5.4.0 ERC20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 WWW (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which at launch is the ProjectFactory; the factory then pays the supply out (swarm share to the launch's MerkleDistributor, 85% to seed the single-sided pool, the remainder to economics.remainderTo). The contract has no owner, admin role, mint, burn, pause, blacklist, freeze, fee, tax or reflection: every transfer and transferFrom moves exactly the requested amount, and nothing can change the supply after deployment. It contains no delegatecall, callcode, selfdestruct, proxy or initializer, and its constructor makes no external calls. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. The pool pairs with IMD (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7) at the launch policy's 1.25% fee with tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (3,800 IMD for the whole supply) and token.totalSupply.
